name: Avalon Care Dental Practice
tagline: Dental care that actually fits your life
heroSubtitle: NHS and private dentistry in Levenshulme with online booking, text reminders, and a team that listens. From routine check-ups to teeth whitening—no pressure, no rushing.

usps.title: Patient-Centred Care
usps.description: Calm, supportive environment with sensory-aware care and commitment to inclusivity. We support initiatives like Autism Awareness Month to ensure every patient feels welcome.

usps.title: Fully Accessible Practice
usps.description: Wheelchair access to reception, toilets, and three surgeries. Downstairs surgeries available on request to accommodate all patients' needs.

usps.title: Modern Facilities
usps.description: Five modern surgeries in Burnage, Manchester, equipped with up-to-date technology and staffed by GDC-registered professionals committed to continuous development.

usps.title: Evidence-Based Treatment
usps.description: All advice grounded in the 'Delivering Better Oral Health' evidence-based toolkit, ensuring patients receive the best prevention and oral care guidance.

usps.title: Convenient Booking
usps.description: Online appointment booking with text and email reminders, making it easy to schedule and manage your dental visits around your life.

usps.title: NHS & Private Options
usps.description: Flexible treatment options with transparent NHS banding charges and cosmetic services available. Many patients exempt from charges, including those under 18.

workflow.title: Book Your Appointment
workflow.description: Use our convenient online booking system or call our friendly reception team. We offer appointment reminders via text and email to keep you on track.

workflow.title: Initial Examination
workflow.description: Your dentist will carry out a comprehensive examination, take X-rays if needed, and discuss any concerns. We listen carefully to understand your goals and needs.

workflow.title: Personalised Treatment Plan
workflow.description: Based on your examination, we'll create a tailored treatment plan suited to your individual needs. We'll explain all options, including NHS and cosmetic choices, with transparent pricing.

workflow.title: Quality Care & Follow-Up
workflow.description: Receive your treatment in our modern surgeries with our experienced, GDC-registered team. We focus on long-term oral health through preventative care and ongoing support.

faqs.question: What are the NHS dental charges at Avalon Care?
faqs.answer: NHS charges are based on three bands: Band 1 (examination, diagnosis, scale, advice) costs £27.90; Band 2 (fillings, root canal, extractions) costs £76.60; Band 3 (crowns, dentures, bridges) costs £332.10. You pay one charge per course of treatment, regardless of how many visits you need.

faqs.question: Are there patients exempt from NHS dental charges?
faqs.answer: Yes. Exempt patients include pregnant women, people in receipt of certain benefits, and patients under 18 years of age. Please contact our reception team for more information on your eligibility.

faqs.question: Can you help with gum disease and bleeding gums?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our dedicated hygienist Faryal Shafique specialises in treating periodontal diseases. We offer gum health assessments, scaling, and personalised advice to help maintain healthy gums. We also run an oral health clinic with up to 20 minutes of dedicated guidance.

faqs.question: Do you offer cosmetic dentistry?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide cosmetic treatments including professional teeth whitening (from £350), composite white fillings (from £149), and clear aligners. Book a consultation (from £65) to discuss your goals and receive a personalised quotation.

faqs.question: Is the practice accessible for disabled patients?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have wheelchair access to our reception area, toilets, and three of our surgeries. When you book, request a downstairs surgery if needed, and our team will accommodate your requirements.

faqs.question: What preventative care do you offer for children?
faqs.answer: For children aged 3 and over, we offer fluoride varnish application to help prevent tooth decay, toothbrush instruction, and diet advice. These services are free for NHS patients. Ask your dentist about our oral health clinic during your next visit.

detailedServices.title: NHS Dental Examination & Diagnosis
detailedServices.description: Comprehensive examination, diagnosis including X-rays, simple scale if needed, and prevention advice. Urgent treatment also covered at this band.

detailedServices.title: Fillings, Root Canal & Extractions
detailedServices.description: NHS treatment covering fillings, root canal work, and tooth extractions as part of a complete course of treatment.
features: All included in one course charge

detailedServices.title: Crowns, Dentures & Bridges
detailedServices.description: NHS treatment for crowns, dentures, and bridges to restore missing or damaged teeth as part of your overall treatment plan.
features: Single course charge covers all visits

detailedServices.title: Hygiene & Gum Care
detailedServices.description: Dedicated hygienist services with Faryal Shafique, our specialist in periodontal disease treatment, plus oral health clinic with up to 20 minutes of dedicated guidance.

detailedServices.title: Cosmetic Dentistry & Teeth Whitening
detailedServices.description: Professional teeth whitening and cosmetic treatments tailored to your individual goals. Consultations available to discuss all cosmetic options.

detailedServices.title: Children's Dental Care
detailedServices.description: Comprehensive NHS dental care for children aged 3 and over, including fluoride varnish application, toothbrush instruction, and diet advice to prevent tooth decay.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: The receptionists were friendly, respectful and accommodating when I rang to make my appointment. The whole team made me feel at ease. Highly recommend Avalon Care for their professional and caring approach to dental treatment.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Excellent NHS dental care. The practice is clean, modern and welcoming. My dentist took time to explain everything and answered all my questions. Very impressed with the level of care and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Emma L.
reviews.text: Great experience at Avalon Care. The team is professional and the practice is accessible and comfortable. Online booking is really convenient. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a reliable dentist in Levenshulme.

reviews.author: Michael P.
reviews.text: Had my hygiene appointment with Faryal and was very impressed. Professional treatment and great advice on maintaining my gum health. The practice is modern and the staff are genuinely caring. Would come back again.
